quay cóp.gloss: to cheat by sneakily copying others' work or available documents during a school test
quay cóp.source: The result of copying; an identical or nearly identical duplicate of an original; The result of gene or chromosomal duplication

quy lát.source: breech, breechblock (of rifle, etc.); cylinder head (of engine)

quán net.source: A mesh of string, cord or rope; A device made from such mesh, used for catching fish, butterflies, etc

quần chíp.source: A movement to do something, a beginning; An act of shifting; a slight movement or change

quắc.source: In the Standard Model, one of a number of elementary subatomic particles having fractional electric charge that forms matter. They are theorized not to exist in isolation, but only in combinations in hadrons such as neutrons and protons or in quark–gluon plasmas; An integer that uniquely identifies a text string
